findings: All four complete raw report member byte lengths and SHA256 digests matched the pinned 93e records, after each fixed original ZIP digest was checked. The four source guard members were accepted by the unchanged reader.

The three campaign baseline phases each contain seven observed successful imports. Their checkpoint counts are 82,913, 82,930 and 82,936; recorded checkpoint wall sums are 6,601,991,452 / 5,964,185,337 / 6,962,409,772 ns and invoking-thread CPU sums are 4,556,264,853 / 4,570,351,415 / 4,570,681,824 ns.

These Host values cover each phase's observed History imports. They establish substantial measured Host work in that scope, but do not show that Host work exclusively accounts for, or dominates, account_graph wall time or caller-thread CPU. There is no graph-only Host timer in this readback.

All six pressure-phase failed imports have valid observers and remain failed. Their recorded Host invocations were accepted; this is not evidence that the enclosing import or business acceptance succeeded, and does not identify which later or separate checkpoint returned the deadline.
The F0 valid-work-root phase contains no History records. No Host timing or call total can be inferred for that phase from the empty array.

No original business failure was closed by this read-only extraction. Original confirmation booleans and unobserved planned slots are preserved exactly; their pressure-window meaning is not a new four-second SLO evaluation.

cpu_and_time_types.client_import_cpu: Original caller-thread CPU for the import observation; scoped worker CPU is not included in this caller-only value.
cpu_and_time_types.host_cpu: Sum of the original per-invocation current-thread CPU samples. Every invoking thread may contribute; it is not process CPU or an exclusive fraction of caller-only/account_graph CPU.
cpu_and_time_types.host_wall: Sum of recorded invocation durations. Nested and parallel intervals may overlap; not an end-to-end phase elapsed time.
cpu_and_time_types.observation_epochs: Host observation epochs differ from campaign/client epochs. Fresh per-import observations are not before/after cumulative snapshots.
cpu_and_time_types.unfinished: No unfinished invocation is present in these measured rows. The unchanged reader retains unfinished durations where present without treating them as accepted/completed.
cpu_and_time_types.unknown: Missing, invalid, unentered or failed-measurement timing is not zero. Any complete aggregate with missing required observations remains null; known subsets are separately retained.
cpu_and_time_types.no_subtraction: Do not subtract Host CPU/wall from account_graph, caller-import or enclosing stage totals. Do not interpret wall minus CPU as disk I/O, CPU throttling or scheduler delay.
